values.name: No Issue
values.description: Indicates that receiver of the documents sends the message just to update the status and there are no problems with document processing.

values.name: References incorrect
values.description: Indicates that the received document did not contain references as required by the receiver for correctly routing the document for approval or processing.

values.name: Legal information incorrect
values.description: Information in the received document is not according to legal requirements.

values.name: Receiver unknown
values.description: The party to which the document is addressed is not known.

values.name: Item quality insufficient
values.description: Unacceptable or incorrect quality.

values.name: Delivery issues
values.description: Delivery proposed or provided is not acceptable.

values.name: Prices incorrect
values.description: Prices not according to previous expectation.

values.name: Quantity incorrect
values.description: Quantity not according to previous expectation.

values.name: Items incorrect
values.description: Items not according to previous expectation.

values.name: Payment terms incorrect
values.description: Payment terms not according to previous expectation.

values.name: Not recognized
values.description: Commercial transaction not recognized.

values.name: Finance incorrect
values.description: Finance terms not according to previous expectation.

values.name: Partially Paid
values.description: Payment is partially but not fully paid.

values.name: Other
values.description: Reason for status is not defined by code.

values.name: No action required
values.description: No action required.

values.name: Provide information
values.description: Missing information requested without re-issuing invoice.

values.description: Request to re-issue a corrected invoice.

values.description: Request to fully cancel the referenced invoice with a credit note.
